review_reasons: Requires new mathematics: A rigorous theory connecting analytical singularity categories to cobordism categories, including: (1) A precise definition of the singularity category Sing(M) that captures all relevant local analytical data, (2) A functor from Sing(M) to a suitable point-like subcategory of Cob(M), (3) Proof that this functor satisfies the hypotheses of the cobordism hypothesis
